title: Growing random planar network with oriented branching and fusion
summary: We consider a growing planar network where a tip grows at constant speed, branches at constant rate and inactivates when it meets a branch already created. We only consider here orthogonal branching occurring always in the same direction. This yields a spatial branching property to the growing network. The connected components of the network then form a branching process of rectangles with double immigration.
